text: The getter slot comes first, then the setter, matching the built-in CCW layout for [ComVisible(true)] interfaces so they stay wire-compatible. propputref only exists in TLB metadata and IDispatch, not an IUnknown vtable; init-vs-set is a C# call-site distinction. Other shapes get SYSLIB1091 so support can expand later without breaking users. A property with bodies is a default-implemented member with no slot (docs/design/libraries/ComInterfaceGenerator/Properties.md).
